title: Brodie's Lakeside Marina, Boat Rentals & Lodging

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Brodie’s Lakeside boasts a fleet of new and late model boats to prioritize peace of mind, comfort and enjoyment during your boat rental experience this summer. Our experienced staff will educate you on boating safety, navigation and how to get the most out of your Lake George boat rental, making sure you are comfortable in all aspects of driving the boat during your rental prior to departure. Our new fleet will fit all your boat rental needs and vacation plans. If we are sold out, please click here.
